chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Gorou — Inuzaka All-Round Defense, All Streams Flow to the Sea, and Water's Edge on Seapunk, then Coral Guard, dealing 25 damage and gaining 5 Block.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered replacing Water's Edge with the second Coral Guard, giving up 6 damage to gain 5 more Block against the telegraphed attack.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up preventing another 5 damage; after 5 Block, the 11-damage attack still deals 6.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. With no incoming attack, I would replace Coral Guard with another Water's Edge for 6 more damage.
